ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_CCD] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT AS(
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId,LimitTypeId ORDER BY InsertDttm DESC ) RN, * FROM (
SELECT * FROM (
	-- Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT -- CRDACCT_CRLIMIT
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	FROM  BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC WHERE BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Temporary Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EFF -- CRDACCT_TEMP_CRLIMIT
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Temporary Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_TEMP_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	FROM  BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC WHERE BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Permanent Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_TIME_MAINT -- CRDACCT_PERM_CRLIMIT 
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Permanent Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_PERM_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
	WHERE BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Last Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_DTE_LST_CREDIT_LIMIT -- CRDACCT_LST_CRLIMIT 
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Last Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_LST_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	FROM  BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
	 WHERE BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Cash Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_TIME_MAINT -- CRDACCT_CASHLIMIT 
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Cash Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_CASHLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
	WHERE BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Installment Limit -- CRDACCT_TIME_MAINT -- CRDACCT_INSTL_LMT 
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Installment Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_INSTL_LMT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm

	FROM  BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
	WHERE BCC.isLatest = '1'
) DAILY

UNION ALL

SELECT * FROM (
	
	-- Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT -- CRDACCT_CRLIMIT
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	FROM  BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
	WHERE BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Temporary Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EFF -- CRDACCT_TEMP_CRLIMIT
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Temporary Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_TEMP_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	FROM  BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
	WHERE BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Permanent Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_TIME_MAINT -- CRDACCT_PERM_CRLIMIT 
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Permanent Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_PERM_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	FROM  BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
	WHERE BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Last Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_DTE_LST_CREDIT_LIMIT -- CRDACCT_LST_CRLIMIT 
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Last Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_LST_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	FROM  BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
	WHERE BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Cash Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_TIME_MAINT -- CRDACCT_CASHLIMIT 
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Cash Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_CASHLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	FROM  BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
	WHERE BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Installment Limit -- CRDACCT_TIME_MAINT -- CRDACCT_INSTL_LMT 
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Installment Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_INSTL_LMT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	FROM  BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
	WHERE BCC.isLatest = '1'
	) MONTHLY
)A
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT WHERE RN = 1 AND CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL;



WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_SRC AS (
    SELECT 
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
		convert(varchar,customeraccountid)
		,convert(varchar,LimitTypeId)
		,convert(numeric,LimitAmount)
		,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
				)) AS HASHROW, CustomerAccountId,LimitTypeId, Timestamp, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_TGT AS (
    SELECT  
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
		convert(varchar,A.customeraccountid)
		,convert(varchar,A.LimitTypeId)
		,convert(numeric,A.LimitAmount)
		,convert(varchar,A.FinancialInstitutionId)
				)) AS HASHROW, A.CustomerAccountId,A.LimitTypeId, A.Timestamp, A.FinancialInstitutionId, A.SourceSystemCode
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLimit A
	JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLimit GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId ) B
		ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
	WHERE A.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_DELTA AS (
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,ISNULL(SRC.LimitTypeId,TGT.LimitTypeId) AS LimitTypeId		
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId	
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode	
		,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'INSERT'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.LimitTypeId = TGT.LimitTypeId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_DELTA;

;


--INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountLimit (
--	[CustomerAccountId]
--	,[LimitTypeId]
--	,[Timestamp]
--	,[LimitAmount]
--	,[LimitEndTimestamp]
--	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
--	,[SourceSystemCode]
--	,[TaskRunId]
--	,[WorkFlowId]
--	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
distinct
	SRC.[CustomerAccountId]
	,SRC.[LimitTypeId]
	,convert(date,convert(varchar,SRC.Timestamp)) AS [Timestamp]
	,SRC.[LimitAmount]
	,convert(date,convert(varchar,SRC.LimitEndTimestamp)) AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
	,SRC.[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,SRC.[SourceSystemCode]
	,SRC.[TaskRunId]
	,SRC.[WorkFlowId]
	,SRC.[InsertDttm]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLimit_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId 
AND DELTA.LimitTypeId = SRC.LimitTypeId  
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_DELTA;

END
